name: Towing and Roadside Operations
audience: independent towing, roadside-assistance, and vehicle-storage operators
topic: vehicle custody, releases, and third-party payment evidence for towing companies

products.name: Vehicle Release Authorization
products.product: A focused towing vehicle release authorization workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent towing, roadside-assistance, and vehicle-storage operators
products.problem: Ownership, lienholder direction, fees, identification, property pickup, and release authority are reviewed across calls and paper records.
products.valueProposition: Turns towing vehicle release authorization into a visible operating queue so every stored vehicle leaves only after the required authority, payment decision, identity, and custody handoff are documented.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets towing vehicle release authorization software, towing vehicle release authorization tracker, towing vehicle release authorization template, and towing vehicle release authorization checklist searches.
